## Background

<!-- CHANGE THIS -->

I earned my undergraduate degree at the University of Massachusetts, Amherst, and my major was geography. Within the field of urban planning, I have focused my research on smart cities. I have a keen interest in urban renewal and sustainable urban development areas that rely heavily on urban spatial analysis. Mastering the techniques and capabilities of spatial analysis has provided me with a more multidimensional understanding of the urban landscape and a more granular grasp of the data involved.
